title: Tested: Where Does The Tone Come From In An Electric Guitar?
summary: Guitarist Jim Lill methodically tests what in an electric guitar affects its tone, swapping parts on a partscaster and even trying a 2x4 body. He finds that wood and construction matter far less than people assume.
why: Cited as a fun, experimental debunking of tonewood claims that shows electronics dominate electric guitar sound.

quote.text: I recently came across an excellent video where a guitarist tries to determine exactly which parts of an electric guitar affect its tone.
